item.title: Govt Mandates 20% Local content Procurement Norm For VGF-backed BESS projects
item.description: Ministry of Power (MoP) has recently amended guidelines to mandate the use of a minimum 20% local content of the total project cost in Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) procurements under the Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme. This announcement comes at a time when BESS is not currently included in the notified list under public procurement norms. item.title: NTPC Awards Major Solar EPC Contracts Ahead of Year-End
item.description: As the calendar year draws to a close, India’s state-run power producer NTPC has awarded multiple solar EPC contracts under its renewable energy arm, signalling a strong push toward accelerating project execution and capacity addition. The recent tenders include awards to Solarworld Energy Solutions, Vikran Engineering, and Bondada Engineering, collectively adding nearly a gigawatt of new solar capacity to NTPC’s growing portfolio. item.title: Sangam Enters EPC Contract With ib Vogt for 27 MW Rajasthan Solar Project
item.description: Rajasthan-based Sangam India has entered into an EPC contract with ib Vogt Solar India Private Limited. While sharing these details in a regulatory filing, Sangam India explained its goal of setting up a 27.00 MWp (variation ±5%) solar power plant through this contract at a village in Sangarh, Tehsil Fatehgarh, District Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. Additionally, the project will support the company’s goal of increasing renewable energy usage and reducing energy costs by setting up a solar power plant.

item.title: Compressed Air Storage Firm Hydrostor gets Key Approval For 500 MW Storage Center
item.description: The California Energy Commission has issued its final permit for the Willow Rock Energy Storage Center, a first-of-its-kind energy storage system capable of discharging at full power for up to eight hours. The 500 MW/4 GWh project will deploy Hydrostor’s proprietary compressed-air technology, marking a major milestone in long-duration energy storage deployment. item.title: SECI Seeks Developers for On-Demand 1,000 MW/8,000 MWh Pumped Storage Project
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued a 1,000 MW/8,000 MWh pumped storage project (PSP-I) tender under the Build, Own, Operate (BOO) model, with an eight-hour (1,000 MW × 8 hours) storage capacity. SECI has sought bids for the project until February 9, 2026.
